captions.caption: A street scene during a hurricane with high winds and rain.
Palm trees swaying violently in strong winds and heavy rain.
Debris flying across the street amidst a powerful storm.
Intense rainfall and wind obscuring the view of buildings and palm trees.
Gusty winds blowing rain horizontally across a deserted street.
A piece of white debris flying through the air during a storm.
Heavy rain and wind battering a row of palm trees.
View of a storm-ravaged street with a street sign in the foreground.
Raindrops on the camera lens as a storm rages in the background.
High winds whipping through palm trees and buildings.
A street sign shaking violently in the intense wind.
More debris flying past as the storm intensifies.
Extremely heavy rain reducing visibility to near zero.
Wind and rain lashing against a building in the distance.
Shot transitions to a McDonald's sign through a rain-streaked window.
A McDonald's restaurant visible through heavy rain and high winds.
Strong winds blowing debris around the McDonald's parking lot.
Visibility worsening as the hurricane eyewall approaches the McDonald's.
Rain lashing the side of the car, with the McDonald's sign in view.
Wind gusts shaking the camera during a shot of the fast-food restaurant.
Debris flying horizontally through the air near the McDonald's building.
Intense rain and wind obscuring the McDonald's sign.
Torrential rain pouring down over the street and restaurant.
Wind whipping through power lines near the McDonald's location.
Shot changes to palm trees being blown nearly sideways by the wind.
Palm trees bending under the force of hurricane-strength winds.
A large piece of debris flying across an open field during the storm.
High winds and rain continuing to batter the coastal landscape.
Palm tree fronds being torn apart by the powerful wind.
Visibility significantly reduced by driving rain and spray.
Shot transitions to a parking garage entrance during the hurricane.
Rain blowing into the parking garage area as the wind howls.
A walkway bridge visible through the intense storm conditions.
Wind gusts throwing water and debris through the parking structure entrance.
Heavy rain and wind making the outdoor scene look like a whiteout.
Parts of a building being buffeted by extreme hurricane winds.
Water flooding the ground near the parking garage entrance.
Debris flying through the air outside the parking garage.
The intensity of the wind and rain continues to increase.
Shot changes to the interior of a parking garage with rain blowing in.
Rain mist filling the interior of the parking garage due to high winds.
A car parked inside the garage as wind and rain whip through the space.
Debris sliding across the wet floor of the parking garage.
Powerful gusts of wind pushing rain deep into the parking structure.
View of the storm outside through the bars of the parking garage.
Mist and spray swirling inside the garage from the hurricane outside.
More debris blowing across the floor of the parking garage.
The wind howling as it passes through the open areas of the building.
Heavy rain falling just outside the parking garage entrance.
Camera pans to show the extent of the mist inside the garage.
Wind and rain creating a hazy atmosphere inside the parking structure.
A piece of debris flying past the parked car in the garage.
Torrential rain visible through the garage's open side.
Shot transitions to a parking gate arm outside being buffeted by wind.
Intense wind and rain whipping around a parking gate entrance.
Debris flying across the ground near the parking gate.
Visibility dropping significantly as a major wind gust hits.
A large object flying through the air during the storm surge.
Rain and wind creating a complete whiteout at the parking entrance.
The parking gate arm shaking violently in the hurricane winds.
